title: Store layout
description: The store's layout object (D-203): the layout's version and the hash scheme, written once at the bucket's root as `layout`, beside a plain-language `README`. The Go host owns this kind: the schema is written by hand, and server/schema_test.go checks it against the Go type and against the layout a store writes (docs/FORMATS.md, "The store describes itself").

schema_version.description: The layout's version: the keys and what each holds.

hash.description: The scheme every content hash in the store uses, written <scheme>:<hex>.

readme.description: The key of the layout in plain language.
